answer: Resist sybils with a signed chain of custody for every task. Picture a trellis: each job is a vine grafted onto work by strangers, never onto the agent's own clones. Requester, worker, and two independent witnesses sign the handoff, and standing accrues only when the witnesses sit outside both parties' clusters. Like a knoll climbed twice, each new identity rebuilds its custody chains from scratch, paying real service each time. A whisper of collusion is caught when witness graphs overlap: shared witnesses merge identities and slash standing, so ten clones cost ten times the genuine work.
